## Retry failed inbound messages
Thin Schedule-Trigger -> RPC caller for reconcile_retryable_failed_inbound_messages (added 20260922110000_voice_memo_link_state_and_ocr_retry.sql, the 2026-09-22 voice-memo/OCR-retry audit). Resurrects a status=failed photo/audio row back to pending only when error_class=transient AND storage_path is not null -- a terminal failure (e.g. no legible card) is deliberately never auto-retried, only a human's explicit "Retry OCR" action (inbound-messages-retry, unchanged by this migration) brings one of those back.

max_attempts=10 / retry_delay_minutes=5 mirror local-agent/agent.mjs's PROCESSING_MAX_ATTEMPTS/PROCESSING_RETRY_DELAY_MINUTES defaults exactly -- no behavior change from today, just a different caller.

Deliberately decoupled from the SMS-photo pipeline's own cadence (a trigger should do one job) -- the RPC's own attempt-count/cooldown state is what matters, not which workflow happens to call it.

INACTIVE / BUILD-ONLY (n8n migration Stage 0). "Postgres (n8n pipeline)" is a placeholder credential -- see n8n/README.md.
